title: SDKS / Docs / Quickstart Impact Trajectory & Risk Register
creator: Avery Chen
description: Goal: Create a single-pane initiative tracker that surfaces the expected impact trajectory (leading + lagging metrics), owners, and an actionable risk register for all SDKs, docs, and quickstart investments. This ticket captures the product plan, measurement model, and the immediate artifacts required for the Q2 OKR checkpoint. Deliverables: 1) Impact trajectory doc with baseline and projected improvements across activation, time-to-first-call, retention, and error surface; 2) Risk register with mitigation owners and SLAs; 3) Owner/RACI matrix for each quickstart and SDK; 4) Measurement dashboard spec and example queries for console telemetry; 5) Rollout plan tied to SDK releases and docs publishing cadence.
acceptance_criteria: Impact trajectory doc reviewed and approved by DX PMs and two engineering leads
Risk register created with owners assigned and initial mitigations for high/medium risks
Dashboard spec posted in Confluence with example BigQuery queries and cost estimate
Pilot telemetry implemented on one SDK (python) with sample cohort metrics in staging dashboard
Rollout plan sequenced with release windows and fallback criteria documented
milestones: 2026-03-07: Risk register workshop and owner assignments
2026-03-14: Dashboard spec and example queries complete
2026-03-28: Python SDK pilot telemetry emitted to staging dashboard
2026-04-15: Publish tracker and handoff to DX ops
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Pilot): python SDK + README quickstart — telemetry + docs tweak — 1 week
Phase 2 (Staged): node SDK + multi-language quickstart set — monitor activation cohort — 2 weeks
Phase 3 (GA): roll across website quickstarts, bake into onboarding flow, enable console badges for updated quickstarts — gated by telemetry and sign-off
